summary: Phase 1 spans DB-backed task truth, Celery worker boundaries, websocket fan-out, legacy compatibility routes, filesystem-backed snapshots, and the default runtime compose topology.
findings: Task truth crosses database state, websocket publish, provider output artifacts, and preview runtime restart results.
Legacy /api/* and /api/v2 coexist, so risky legacy routes must be tightened without removing compatibility paths.
Websocket log streaming depends on task_service.publish() -> Redis pub/sub -> websocket_manager broadcast.
Rollback integrity depends on site root replacement and subsequent site restart inside site_service.
Isolation work touches both process startup in site_service and host privileges granted by docker-compose.yml.
